name: TCRMINSToStandardTerminology
description: SKELETON ONLY: every element is listed with an "unmatched" target so the mapping work is visible. No LOINC/SNOMED target has been guessed. Fill in `target` after terminology review.

element.display: Open surgery only; no minimally invasive or robotic-assisted surgery
Endoscopic surgery (entry through a natural body opening: e.g. gastroscopy, colonoscopy, bronchoscopy, hysteroscopy, colposcopy, cystoscopy)
Thoracoscopic, laparoscopic, or a similar minimally invasive surgery (percutaneous entry, or a natural opening reopened, into a body cavity)
Minimally invasive or robotic-assisted surgery combined with, or converted to, open surgery

Not applicable: no primary-site surgery; primary-site surgery coded 100-190; prostate cancer primary-site surgery coded 210-270; primary-site surgery performed at another hospital; diagnosis year 2017 or earlier; or a haematopoietic/reticuloendothelial/immunoproliferative/myeloproliferative neoplasm
